data.name: Frederick
data.gender_notes: Frederick is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German 'fridric', meaning 'peaceful ruler' or 'protector of the peace'. In Christian tradition, it is also associated with Frederick I Barbarossa (1122-1190), a German Holy Roman Emperor known for his military prowess and piety. The name Frederick carries the meaning “Peaceful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Frederick usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Frederick belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Frederick total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Frederick holds significant cultural impact, particularly in the Germanic tradition. It is associated with powerful and influential figures in history, such as Frederick II, also known as Frederick the Great (1480-1525), who ruled Prussia from 1740 to 1786 and is remembered for his role in expanding and strengthening the Prussian state. Additionally, Frederick Douglass (1818-1895), a prominent African American abolitionist, author, and statesman, also bore this name. His famous autobiography, "Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass, an American Slave," chronicled his experiences as a slave and his subsequent escape to freedom.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Frederick is a reminder of God's promise of peace and protection to His people. In a broader sense, the name symbolizes the idea of being a peaceful leader or a protector of the peace. This spiritual significance can be seen in the life of Frederick I Barbarossa, who embodied both military strength and deep piety. He was known for his devotion to the Catholic Church and led numerous crusades to protect the holy lands. Therefore, the name Frederick carries the deep meaning of being a peaceful ruler or protector, seeking God's guidance in all matters.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Frederick: God's Peaceful Ruler. A name signifying the peaceful and God-ruled reign of one who bears the title.
